meta.title: Connecting WordPress and MCP · WordCamp Bengaluru 2026
meta.description: Let AI work with your WordPress site, safely. Paste one prompt into your coding agent and it sets up a local WordPress your AI app can talk to.

hero.titleBefore: Let AI work with your WordPress site,
hero.lede: One prompt sets up a real WordPress site on your laptop, with the official MCP Adapter, and connects it to your AI app.

step1.label: Step 1 · The easy way
step1.title: Paste this into your coding agent
step1.prompt: Set up the WordCamp Bengaluru WordPress + MCP demo for me by following https://github.com/hunr-ai/wordcamp-blr-mcp-kit/blob/main/AGENT_SETUP.md
step1.worksWith: Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf…
step1.aside: No terminal? No problem. Your agent knows where it is.

step2.label: Step 2 · No coding agent?
step2.title: Double-click instead
step2.lede: Same result, one launcher. You need Node.js 22 or newer; the launcher tells you how to get it if it's missing.

steps: Download the ZIP and open your Downloads folder.
Right-click the ZIP, choose “Extract All…”, then open the new folder.
Double-click Start-Windows.cmd. If Windows says it protected your PC, click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
Keep the window open. When it says your site is running, restart your AI app and try a prompt below.
Download the ZIP and double-click it in Downloads to unzip (Safari may already have done this).
Right-click Start-macOS.command and choose Open, then Open again. No Open button? Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click “Open Anyway”.
Keep the Terminal window open. When it says your site is running, restart your AI app and try a prompt below.

prompts.label: Step 3
prompts.title: Try these prompts
prompts.lede: Restart your AI app first so it picks up the new tools. Then just ask.

items.text: Are you connected to my WordPress site? What is it called and what version is it running?
Run a content audit and give me the top 3 things to fix this week.
Run an SEO check on “WordPress 7.2 is almost here”, rewrite it to fix every issue, and save the result as a new draft.
Write a 400-word recap of WordCamp Bengaluru 2026 with two subheadings and an excerpt. Category: Community. Save it as a draft.
Delete all posts on my site.
items.note: Try to break it. It can't, on purpose.

items.title: WordPress Playground
items.text: A real WordPress running on your laptop. No PHP, MySQL or Docker. It resets every time you stop it.

items.title: Official MCP Adapter
items.text: The WordPress.org plugin that turns your site's abilities into tools AI apps understand.

items.title: Your AI app
items.text: Claude, Cursor, VS Code and friends connect over MCP, the open standard for AI tools.

safety.label: Safety
safety.title: Built to be safe to play with
bullets: Everything stays on your laptop at 127.0.0.1. Nothing goes on the internet, and the site starts fresh every time.
The AI only sees the abilities your site chooses to share. There's a “delete all posts” ability in there, and the AI can't even see it.
Agents draft, humans publish. The AI signs in with an Application Password you can revoke in one click.
